# Factions & Organizations

## Aid Society {#aid-society}

The Aid Society is a local group whose members, including women like Mrs. Jasper Bell, periodically gather at members' homes such as [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) for meetings and tea.

**Members:** [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)

> [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md) returns to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) with the twins, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) and [Dora](../character/dora.md) Keith, following their mother's funeral. [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) quickly proves to be a handful, causing a scene at church by dropping a caterpillar down [Lauretta](../character/lauretta.md) White's dress and later tricking [Dora](../character/dora.md) into falling in the pigpen. After being punished for his antics, [Davy](../character/davy-keith.md) confesses to [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) that he also hid a toad in Marilla's bed.
>
> — v2 · VIII Marilla Adopts Twins

## American {#american}

The Americans are wealthy summer visitors, including artists and millionaires, who frequent local hotels like the [White Sands Hotel](../codex/places.md#white-sands-hotel) for the coastal scenery.

## Boulters {#boulters}

The Boulters are a local family noted by [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) for having a strongly developed, contrary streak.

## Canadian Woman {#canadian-woman}

The Canadian Woman is a publication to which [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) suggests [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) send her written garden idyl.

## Conservative {#conservative}

The Conservatives are a political party in [Canada](../codex/places.md#canada), supported by [Matthew](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md), [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), and [Marilla](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), and opposed by Liberals such as [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md).

**Members:** [Marilla Cuthbert](../character/marilla-cuthbert.md), [Matthew Cuthbert](../character/matthew-cuthbert.md)

## Cottons {#cottons}

The Cottons are a family whose three pallid little girls were among the ten newcomers attending the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) school.

## Cuthberts {#cuthberts}

The Cuthberts are a quiet and reserved family residing at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), a secluded and meticulously clean homestead situated at the edge of cleared land in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea).

## Debating Club {#debating-club}

[The Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Debating Club is a respectable local organization that meets fortnightly throughout the winter and hosts entertainments at the hall, such as a major paid concert featuring music, recitations, and an address by the minister to benefit the library.

## French {#french}

The French are a group whose half-grown boys are sometimes hired for farm work, though they are considered unreliable by locals due to their tendency to leave for lobster canneries or the United [States](../codex/places.md#states) once trained.

## Grits {#grits}

The Grits are a political party in [Canada](../codex/places.md#canada) whose members include [Prissy](../character/prissy-andrews.md) Andrews's father, Mr. [Phillips](../character/phillips.md), and several boys at school.

## Improvement Society {#improvement-society}

The Improvement Society is an [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) organization conceived by [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) and supported by local youth to make the village prettier through projects like cleaning up land, removing dilapidated structures, and repainting the hall.

**Members:** [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md), [Jane](../character/jane.md), [Jane Andrews](../character/jane-andrews.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Oliver Sloane](../character/oliver-sloane.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)

## Improvers {#improvers}

The Improvers, also known as the [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) Village [Improvement Society](../codex/factions.md#improvement-society) (A.V.I.S.), is a flourishing local organization that works to beautify the community through projects such as clearing road fronts, planting flower beds, and petitioning for improvements to public and church grounds.

**Members:** [Diana Barry](../character/diana-barry.md), [Fred Wright](../character/fred-wright.md), [Gertie Pye](../character/gertie-pye.md), [Julia Bell](../character/julia-bell.md), [Priscilla Grant](../character/priscilla-grant.md)

## Liberal {#liberal}

The Liberal party is a political group whose members include [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md), old [Martin](../character/martin.md) Bovyer, and [Diana](../character/diana-barry.md) Barry's father.

**Members:** [Martin](../character/martin.md), [Rachel Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md)

## Pyes {#pyes}

The Pyes are a family whose members include Roger, Joshua, [John Andrew](../character/john-andrew.md), and Anthony, who earn a reputation for making a mess of things after bungling a paint order and painting the hall a bright blue instead of green.

## Sloanes {#sloanes}

The Sloanes are a family in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) whose members refused to deal with the Bell family after a dispute regarding their respective roles in a school concert program.

## Yankee {#yankee}

A Yankee refers to a person from or associated with the United [States](../codex/places.md#states), whom locals such as Mrs. Rachel [Lynde](../character/rachel-lynde.md) view with skepticism and prejudice.
